reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was zero reviews and a $1 a day price for 200 mg, and I never buy without hundreds of reviews where I can read the 1-star ones. My usual bottle is far cheaper per serving, and I already have Subscribe & Save set up for it.
objection: No reviews at all, so I can't check complaints about capsule size, stomach upset or whether the dose is real. A QR lab report is nice, but I'd still be the guinea pig at $30.
would_change_my_mind: Several hundred reviews with a solid average and few complaints about swallowing or stomach, plus a lower price per serving or a Subscribe & Save discount.
